verses.1: And it happened that, after Jesus finished speaking these words, he left Galilee and went to the borders of Judea, beyond the Jordan River.
verses.2: And many people followed him. He healed them there.
verses.3: And the Pharisees came to him, trying to provoke him. They said, “Is it right for a man to abandon his wife for any reason whatsoever?”
verses.4: But the one who answered said, “Do you not know that the builder created them from scratch, and made them into what they are today?”
verses.5: And he said, “Because of this, a man will abandon his father and mother. He will also become attached to his wife. And both of them will be united in one body.”
verses.6: So that there are no two separate beings anymore, but one single being. This is what God has united into one person, so that no one can be separated from Him.
verses.7: They say to him, “What reason did Moses have for giving a book of prohibition and prohibiting it?”
verses.8: He says to them that Moses allowed them to divorce their wives, because of their stubbornness. But from the beginning, it wasn’t like that.
verses.9: I say to you that whoever divorces his wife and does not marry another woman, he is guilty of adultery. And whoever marries the divorced woman is also guilty of adultery.
verses.10: The disciples say to him, “If that is indeed the reason for a man to be separated from his wife, then it is not appropriate to marry.”
verses.11: And he said to them, “Not everyone will accept this message. Only those who are willing to listen.”
verses.12: For there are those who are rich because they were born into wealthy families; there are also those who become rich through human efforts; and there are those who become rich by virtue of the kingdom of heaven. Those who have the ability to be generous, may be generous.
verses.13: At that time, children were brought to him, so that he could touch their hands and bless them. The disciples also praised them.
verses.14: But Jesus said, “Go away, children, and do not keep them back from coming to me. For those who are like these will be the kingdom of heaven.”
verses.15: And when he put his hands on them, they were moved there from that place.
verses.16: And someone came up to him and said, “Teacher, what is the best thing I can do in order to live a eternal life?”
verses.17: And he said to him, “What do you ask of me regarding goodness? Goodness is something that can be achieved through obedience to commands. If you truly want to enter into life, then obey these commands.”
verses.18: He said to him, “Which one?” But Jesus replied, “Do not commit murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, and do not lie.”
verses.19: Love your father and mother, and also love those who are near you as if they were yourself.
verses.20: The young man said to him, “I’ve planned everything. What more do I need to do?”
verses.21: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, then sell what you have and give it to the poor. Also, store up treasures in heaven. And follow me.”
verses.22: But when the young man heard those words, he became sad, as he had many possessions to lose.
verses.23: And Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you that those who are rich will be brought low and enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.24: Once again, I say to you: It is better to suffer a little pain in order to become rich in the kingdom of God, rather than being rich but still suffering.
verses.25: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished. They said, “Who then can be saved?”
verses.26: When Jesus looked at them, he said to them, “It is impossible for people to do this, but for God, everything is possible.”
verses.27: Then Peter replied to him, “Look, we have left everything behind and followed you. What will be our reward then?”
verses.28: And Jesus said to them, “I tell you that those of you who follow me in this life, when the Son of Man sits on his throne of glory, you shall also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
verses.29: And anyone who loses their home, brothers, or sisters, father, mother, wife, children, or fields because of my name, will be granted a hundredfold reward and eternal life.
verses.30: Many will be first in the evening, and those who are late will also be first in the evening.
